design_description: A high-energy black and electric-orange design built around an organic cracked / molten energy texture. The black base dominates, while irregular orange fissures spread across the shoulders, sleeves and torso, creating the impression of heat or energy breaking through the surface. The pattern becomes progressively more intense toward the lower front, where the orange forms a large symmetrical eruption that rises from the hem. Thin orange contour lines along both sides reinforce the athletic silhouette and visually frame the central composition. The Alpha Energy sponsor is the main focal point, positioned centrally in crisp white and orange with its lightning symbol above. The club crest and additional chest branding follow the same restrained black/orange language, keeping the entire identity cohesive. Orange is also used selectively on the collar piping and sleeve cuffs, providing clean structural accents against the predominantly black jersey. Overall, it is an aggressive, energetic football design combining volcanic/cracked textures, symmetrical lower-body graphics and controlled orange detailing, visually connecting the kit directly to the Alpha Energy concept.
